tool.provenance: The official release checksum table publishes this SHA-1. The cached jar matches it. SHA-256 was computed over those same bytes and is enforced before execution. Java and the jar are never committed.
tool.mode: Breadth-first complete reachable-state exploration. No simulation, depth cutoff, fairness or temporal liveness property. Terminal deadlocks are permitted.

bounds.observer: Any captured subset of visible symbolic records with independent complete/incomplete marker; one final classification, no atomic snapshot promise.

mapping.boundary: Pending open, partial/complete write, atomic hard link, readback and reply. Existing identical canonical destination is represented by set union. Interrupted pending names remain ignored; retry reuses record identity with a fresh pending file. Metadata/readback/unlink are silent under ordinary immutable-file assumptions. Existing-only namespace/export-safety preflight may refuse before pending creation; it adds no canonical effect and is silent under the configured ordinary immutable-directory assumptions. Native folder identity and cloud sync are separate acceptance.

Bounded directory entries and per-file parsing may return a captured subset, complete false for corrupt/unknown entries or exhausted bounds. Model bad is untrusted sync, not a producer write. No global atomic snapshot. Diagnostic names are hashed; this does not change captured records or completeness.

Two symbolic successor records share predecessor a and logical identity. Missing predecessor, invalid bytes, incomplete scan or two leaves prevent usable execution. accepted abstracts only this usable predicate, not global ready: missing automation/report or other findings may still require attention.

run and receipt assurance reported, even with producer verified delivery reference. Clock comparison adds explicit stale flag/finding while historical reported execution remains. Boolean staleInput abstracts exact age arithmetic; no real clock guarantee. Run timing.observedAt is another sourceTimes age input; actualTiming retains supplied fields or explicit nulls. Timing timestamp ordering and measurement truth are outside TLC.
Validated records and collision-free canonical digest identity are assumed. Parser rules and content schema are behavioral controls, not exhaustively proved by TLC.

Pure predecessor validation before publication and aggregate usable projection. Terminal execution cannot change on same-key successor; verified receipt cannot regress. Same-terminal attachments permitted. Subject and occurrence binding are additionally guarded but outside this finite transition model.

Expected occurrence with no observed run retains execution not-inferred, never completed. CreateRun is an explicit producer supplied claim and is never inferred from the slot. Empty inventory and enabled definitions without observed invocations also require observation attention in executable controls; no synthetic run is created. Global health summaries remain outside this finite transition model.

assumptions: Collision-free digests; complete writes contain exact requested bytes.
Atomic same-filesystem hard links; ordinary immutable canonical files and fresh unique pending names.
No external deletion or mutation of already-published producer bytes; corrupt sync is separate untrusted input.
Successful operations and duplicate hard-link collisions only; arbitrary I/O errors and power-loss durability excluded.
Finite bounded exploration; no fairness, liveness, unbounded record count or global snapshot promise.
